item.title: Men's Basketball: Temple wins on the road against ECU, 81-73
item.description: GREENVILLE, N.C. (WNCT) -- Despite another 30-point performance from Jordan Riley, the Owls completed a season-sweep over the Pirates with a 81-73 win, marking ECU's 16th loss of the season. Watch the video for highlights and more.
